text:
leah-sales: Hey team — Oxbridge Med kickoff next Tue. They want a 1-week POC. Primary asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM group sync, RBAC per hospital, and domain proofing. Any immediate blockers?

devon-se: quick q — IdP-initiated only or SP as well?

leah-sales: both. They'll use Okta + AzureAD.

samir-security: sent their security questionnaire back — big items: SOC2 attestation, DPA, SCIM provisioning logs retention window (they want 1 year), and tenant isolation guarantees. Can we get DPA for hosted POC?

maria-ps: For short POC we can spin up a hosted staging tenant and provide POC credits. SCIM bulk import + delta sync: we need to check rate limits; can bump for a timebox.

devon-se: SCIM note: we support SCIM 2.0 with incremental patch (delta) and group membership operations. Default rate limit 10 req/s; can temporarily raise to 50 req/s for POC. For >50k objects we usually recommend Dedicated.

leah-sales: they estimate ~12k users, ~3k groups. They also asked about delegated admin so different hospitals can manage their own users.

maria-ps: RBAC pattern: we create scoped roles tied to org/group namespaces. Delegated admin UI isn't GA on hosted — for fine-grained delegation we propose either Dedicated (managed role isolation) or enable a managed delegation feature under an enterprise add-on (contract).

samir-security: Domain verification: they require DNS TXT proof + optional email verification. They also asked for an explicit tenant isolation statement for PHI. For PHI workloads we recommend Private (VPC) or on-prem; hosted offers logical isolation + encryption at rest but not customer-dedicated networking.

leah-sales: buyer asked if the POC can be free. Also pricing impact if they need delegated admin or Private.

maria-ps: We can grant POC credits to cover hosted infra for 2 weeks. If they insist on Private/VPC for POC, there's a setup fee and 4–6 week provisioning timeline. Delegated admin feature is a paid enterprise add-on (price depends on scope).

devon-se: SAML mapping example (to share with their IdP team):
```
SAML: {
  "NameIDFormat": "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress",
  "Attributes": ["email","givenName","familyName","groups"],
  "ACS": "https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs/<tenant>",
  "SPInit": true,
  "IdPInit": true
}
```

leah-sales: I'll loop in amy-legal to fast-track the DPA. Also need confirmation on SCIM rate bump and whether ops can seed users for the POC.

amy-legal: (joined) I'll push the standard DPA + PHI addendum. If they require Private we need signed SOW — I can draft and aim EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Provisioning request created: #PR-4521 — enable SCIM rate bump for oxbridge-staging (50 req/s) and create staging tenant oxbridge-staging.

devon-se: Action list: 1) confirm SCIM pagination/perf for 12k users (devon) 2) confirm RBAC/delegation pattern docs + example (maria) 3) POC pricing/credits and Private cost estimate (maria + sales) 4) legal: DPA + PHI addendum (amy-legal) 5) domain proof steps + sample TXT record (samir)

leah-sales: Great — I'll schedule kickoff and share the security questionnaire link: https://redwood.ai/sec/q/oxbridge. Tagging @samir-security for any fatal red flags.

samir-security: Quick red flag check: if they push PHI and insist on hosted, that's a blocker until legal signs the addendum. Otherwise looks doable.

maria-ps: I'll prep a short doc with RBAC templates and delegated admin options.

leah-sales: Thanks everyone — I'll report back after kickoff. :thumbsup:
